subject.title: [Bug] Gateway swallows user-visible reply when an agent's exec stdout matches "configuration file" — replies=2 puts ⚠️ 🛠️ first, the actual reply second

question: Should this remaining work preserve core mutating-tool warnings and only clear false/recovered exec warnings, or should OpenClaw suppress exec warning finals after successful assistant replies more broadly?
rationale: Current main has the Feishu rendering fix, but related maintainer discussion rejected broad core stderr/error suppression; choosing the remaining warning policy requires maintainer intent, not an automated repair guess.

options.title: Narrow False/Recovered Warning Fix
options.body: Preserve real mutating-tool warnings, but clear or suppress warnings when the trajectory proves the exec result was successful, read-only, or recovered before the final reply.

options.title: Accept Feishu Coalescing As Sufficient
options.body: Treat v2026.6.11 as enough once live Feishu proof shows the answer remains visible, leaving any extra warning after the answer as intentional diagnostic behavior.

options.title: Broaden Core Exec Suppression
options.body: Suppress exec warning finals after successful assistant replies across channels, accepting the risk that valid diagnostics may become less visible.

recommendation.title: Narrow False/Recovered Warning Fix
recommendation.body: Preserve real mutating-tool warnings, but clear or suppress warnings when the trajectory proves the exec result was successful, read-only, or recovered before the final reply.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the landed Feishu fix and provided the related decision rationale against broad core suppression in the closed alternative PR.
